name: 会話で共有する地図の位置
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese Lighthouse conversation map attachment matching the native LH03-0156 preview. Keep the canvas ratio exactly 390:190 and show only this single map card, with no channel chrome or surrounding conversation.

The card is centered with a white outer margin. Reproduce the pale mint rounded container with the rectangular map inside it. Preserve the map crop from the supplied Telegram source around the blue location pin at the intersection of 9TH ST and N ST: pale streets, muted building blocks, light-green park area and the small Apple Maps label at the lower-left. Use the original source map image as the authority for road/building/park layout and the native preview for crop, rounded card, margins and timestamp placement. Keep one bright blue location pin at the center of the map.

At the lower-right, place the dark forest-green rounded time pill with white text 「21:49」, matching the native preview. Keep the text small and legible. There is no hyperlink text in this component; do not add any blue text or URLs. The blue pin is part of the map artwork and must remain blue.

Do not add a second map, person photo, chat bubble, message text, controls, shadows, or extra map pins. Do not reproduce unrelated Telegram messages from the full source screenshot. Preserve the native Japanese card surface and simple visual treatment.
reviewNotes: 第1版を目視。ネイティブと同じ地図ラベル、青い位置ピン、地図、ミント枠、21:49表示を保持し余計なUIはない。native 390x190比でカード外形は約15px左、約10px下、幅は約10px大きく高さは約9px短い。時刻ピルも約10px右・7px下で、幅が約15px狭い。地図内部の道路/建物細部は元画像と画素単位で一致しない。needs-correctionで保持。所有者受入・ネイティブ編集・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: Primary native preview: exact map-card canvas, crop, mint frame and timestamp
Original Telegram source screenshot: authoritative map image and label geometry; crop [78,204,382,357] in normalized-width-390 coordinates
